notIdeasOfWhatSocietyShouldBe.explanation: Wikipedia defines Brexit as "the withdrawal of the United Kingdom (UK) from the European Union (EU)": a dated process (the 2016 referendum, the Article 50 negotiations, exit on 31 January 2020 and the end of the transition period) rather than a set of ideas. The views behind it (Euroscepticism, national sovereignty) belong to Euroscepticism in the United Kingdom and similar ideologies, audited separately.
